summary: New Era Energy & Digital filed an 8-K disclosing that subsidiary TCDC PowerCo LLC signed a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement on September 18, 2026 with Luminant ET Services for at least 200 MW and up to 207 MW from Vistra's 1,180 MW Odessa, Texas gas plant, feeding its Texas Critical Data Center project. Conditions precedent run to December 31, 2027. New Era must post a $116,000,000 letter of credit within 15 business days and up to $82,800,000 additional security by delivery. A concurrent Development Framework Agreement with Vistra was executed. This is an ordinary commercial energy contract, not a special situation.
